# ModelCanon — Official AI Model Changelog, Deprecation & API Spec MCP Server

> Deterministic, cross-platform MCP server (v0.1.0) for official AI model changelogs, deprecation tracking, and live API specifications across Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Moonshot Kimi on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Packages & Supported Platforms
- npm: `@digital-lake/modelcanon` (`npx -y @digital-lake/modelcanon`)
- PyPI: `modelcanon-mcp` (`uvx modelcanon-mcp` / `pip install modelcanon-mcp`)
- MCP Registry ID: `io.github.digital-lake-ai/modelcanon`
- Supported Operating Systems: Linux (`linux`), macOS (`darwin`), and Windows (`win32`) — Node.js >= 20 & Python >= 3.10

## MCP Tools (Read-Only, `outputSchema` + `structuredContent`)
- `audit_model_id(model_id)`: Checks active/deprecated/retired/unknown status, UTC days until shutdown, official replacement ID, context/output limits, parameter constraints, and source URL.
- `get_latest_updates(provider?, days?, category?, limit?)`: Returns compact extractive changelog and deprecation entries (`source_url` + `confidence`).
- `list_active_models(provider?, include_deprecated?, limit?)`: Lists active (or deprecated) models with context windows, output limits, and pricing per 1M tokens.

## MCP Resources
- `modelcanon://catalog/summary`: Snapshot metadata, provider list, and cache freshness.
- `modelcanon://deprecations/upcoming`: Currently deprecated or shutdown-scheduled models.

## Primary Official Sources
- Gemini: `https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations.md.txt`, `https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt`, `https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/llms.txt`
- Claude: `https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md`, `https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview.md`, `https://platform.claude.com/llms.txt`
- OpenAI: `https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations.md`, `https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog.md`, `https://openai.com/news/rss.xml`
- DeepSeek: `https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates`
- Kimi: `https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/llms.txt`, `https://platform.moonshot.ai/docs/pricing/chat.md`
- Deterministic catalog enrichers: `https://models.dev/api.json`, `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/main/model_prices_and_context_window.json`, `https://models.litellm.ai/changelog.xml`
